definition: the amount you get by adding everything
description: Friends sit at a long wooden counter in a noodle bar, seen through the eyes of one of them, whose hands in blue sleeves push banknotes onto a big pile of money in the middle. A young woman in a rust jumper lays down another note, a smiling man in a white T-shirt drops in coins, and a young woman in a pink top throws her arm up and cheers. The hands in blue sleeves pull back and then gather the pile together. Empty noodle bowls and glasses of water stand around it, and cooks work behind the counter.

taps.target: the man in the white T-shirt
